Sau 10 năm kể từ khi hoàn thành mạng lướ.en: After 10 years since completing the Northern South Railway network and entering the mine, when on 21 October, 1946, Ho Chi Minh Chairman took the first railway route soon after winning independence from the Sea to Hanoi. President Ho Chi Minh sent letters to the Vietnamese Railroads praising the railway staff. From then on, every 21/10 was selected as the traditional day of the Vietnam Railroad.
Sau 10 năm kể từ khi hoàn thành mạng lướ.zh: 在完成北南铁路网并进入矿山10年后,1946年10月21日,胡志明主席在赢得从海独立到河内不久的铁路路线. 胡志明主席致信越南铁道 称赞铁路工作人员. 从那时起,每21/10次被选为越南铁路的传统日.

Sau 13 năm kể từ khi Bộ trường GTVT ký q.en: After 13 years since the GTVT Schools signed the 575/QN/TCCB-RD decision, in 2003 founded the Vietnam Railroad General on the Vietnamese Railroad Union's facilities according to the 34/2003 NMG decision on April 4,2003 of the Government Prime Minister of the Republic of the National Republic of the National Society of Vietnam Phan Phan Pea.
Sau 13 năm kể từ khi Bộ trường GTVT ký q.zh: 在GTVT学校签署575/QN/TCCB-RD决定13年后,根据越南民族共和国总理潘潘培于2003年4月4日作出的第34/2003 NMG决定,在越南铁路联盟的设施上建立了越南铁路总公司.

Sau 24 năm kể từ năm tuyến đường sắt hai.en: After 24 years since the five South North South Vietnamese Railways were restored, in 1990 the Railroad General was converted to the Vietnam Railroad Union according to the decision of 575/QN/TCCB-LDN on April 10,1990 of the Minister of Transportation.
Sau 24 năm kể từ năm tuyến đường sắt hai.zh: 南越五条南越铁路恢复运营24年后,1990年根据交通部长1990年4月10日575/QN/TCCB-LDN的决定,铁路总公司改为越南铁路联盟.

Sau 55 năm tiếp theo, tức là vào năm 193.en: After 55 years, that is, in 1936, the completion of the Northern South Railroad system stretched the country of Vietnam with a total length of up to 250 km.
Sau 55 năm tiếp theo, tức là vào năm 193.zh: 55年后,即1936年,越南北部南铁道系统的完成使越南全国的铁路总长度达到250公里。

Thời điểm đó, trên thế giới kỹ thuật còn.en: At that time, in the world of engineering was primitive and backward, not to mention Vietnam, but in Vietnam did make such a long trans-Vietal railway that was indeed a feat and a great thing. And since then (303 years) the railway network has not ceased to change and progress far above the first period.
Thời điểm đó, trên thế giới kỹ thuật còn.zh: 当时,在工程界是原始的和落后的,更不用提越南了,但是在越南确实制造了这么长的跨越南铁路,这确实是一件壮举和大事. 而自此以后(303年),铁路网并未停止变化,进展远超第一个时期.

Tuyến đường sắt đầu tiên được xây dựng t.en: The first railway line was built in Vietnam in 1881 with a length of only 71 km between the two provinces, the city was USA Tho (Tong Jiang) and Saigon, after 55 years from the first railroads to be born, in 1936 the Transnational Railway of Vietnam was newly exploited and put into use.
Tuyến đường sắt đầu tiên được xây dựng t.zh: 1881年越南建成第一条铁路线,两省之间长度仅71公里,该市为USA Tho(东江)和西贡,距最早诞生的铁路55年后,1936年越南跨国铁路被新开发并投入使用.
